executive_summary: The automated test report for the web application indicates that all smoke and functional tests passed successfully, demonstrating basic functionality and stability. However, there are significant security concerns due to missing critical security headers, which could expose the application to various vulnerabilities.

ai_issues.title: Missing HSTS header
ai_issues.root_cause: The HSTS security header is absent.
ai_issues.business_impact: Without HSTS, the application is vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks, potentially compromising user data.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Implement the HSTS header to enforce secure connections.

ai_issues.title: Missing CSP header
ai_issues.root_cause: The CSP security header is absent.
ai_issues.business_impact: Lack of CSP header increases the risk of cross-site scripting attacks, which can lead to data theft and site defacement.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Add a Content Security Policy header to restrict resources the browser can load.

ai_issues.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
ai_issues.root_cause: The X-Content-Type-Options security header is absent.
ai_issues.business_impact: Without this header, the application is susceptible to MIME type sniffing attacks.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Include the X-Content-Type-Options header with the value 'nosniff'.

ai_issues.title: Missing X-Frame-Options header
ai_issues.root_cause: The X-Frame-Options security header is absent.
ai_issues.business_impact: Absence of this header can lead to clickjacking attacks, compromising user interactions.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Add the X-Frame-Options header to prevent framing of the site.

ai_issues.title: Missing Referrer-Policy header
ai_issues.root_cause: The Referrer-Policy security header is absent.
ai_issues.business_impact: Without this header, referrer information may be leaked, potentially exposing sensitive data.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Implement a Referrer-Policy header to control the amount of referrer information sent.

ai_issues.title: Missing Permissions-Policy header
ai_issues.root_cause: The Permissions-Policy security header is absent.
ai_issues.business_impact: Lack of this header can lead to misuse of browser features and APIs.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Add a Permissions-Policy header to control the use of browser features.
